view_technology: Windows Forms (WinForms), .NET Framework 4.5 — declarative-via-code view definitions in frm*.Designer.cs partial classes (InitializeComponent() imperatively building System.Windows.Forms control trees in C#), no XAML/markup anywhere in scope. Confirmed by direct Read of all 12 frm*.Designer.cs/frm*.cs pairs under YazılımSınamaProjesi/. No custom theme/resource-dictionary file exists anywhere in this codebase; the only styling present is (a) three SystemColors references on the Login screen and (b) three embedded PNG icon resources surfaced via Properties/Resources.Designer.cs. Every other screen renders with entirely unthemed WinForms defaults.

colors.name: login-button-background

colors.name: login-button-foreground
colors.note: OS-theme-relative symbolic color; see login-button-background note.

colors.note: OS-theme-relative symbolic color; see login-button-background note.

omitted.name: typography (font-family / size / weight, all screens)
omitted.reason: No Font property is ever set on any of the 12 forms or their controls anywhere in YazılımSınamaProjesi/ (confirmed by direct inspection of every frm*.Designer.cs/frm*.cs pair) — typography is entirely OS/.NET-default and the effective font stack cannot be determined from source. frmDemirbasIslem.Designer.cs:190 additionally declares a different AutoScaleDimensions (6F,13F) than its 11 sibling forms (8F,16F, e.g. frmGiris.Designer.cs:107), the two values corresponding to different legacy default-font design-time metrics, which compounds the ambiguity about what actually renders at runtime.
